g.text: Provider-years agreeing with the registry state
Share of comparable provider-years whose source-recorded state equals the registry's state, stratified by the registry
state (states with >= 30 comparable provider-years per source). Open triangles mark Oregon and New Mexico, where the
Medicaid file carries no NPI-bearing segment and 'agreement' measures only cross-border records.
Practice-state agreement with the provider registry varies by state
State-level agreement does not establish accuracy: the registry state is the stratifier, not the truth.
